label: synthetic
purpose: The strategy changes the entry threshold and adds the break-even stop change, but only the threshold is declared: an unlisted edit makes the result malformed as RULE_CHANGES_MISMATCH.

evidence.content: Development-window per-stock finding: seed entries often followed a decision bar that closed below the previous close on heavy volume.

claims.rationale: The recorded weakness threshold admits entries that the development-window finding describes.
claims.expected_effect: Entries change in the direction of the finding; evaluation can contradict this, so an adverse or inconclusive comparison against the parent stays possible.
invalidation_conditions: Signal and trade counts do not move in the stated direction against the parent in the development window.
requested_tests: The registered comparison against the parent under the frozen policy.
